purpose: Source-backed TikTok hook/title variation bank for Coachi slideshows. 50 proven structures with 5 Coachi-safe variations each, giving 250 reusable hooks plus slide text sets.

source_policy.use: Copy structure, pacing, and runner vocabulary shape only.
source_policy.do_not_use: Do not copy creator wording, faces, captions, edits, watermarks, or visual identity.
source_policy.production_rule: Generated hooks must be Coachi-native and preserve the TikTok question, contradiction, number, or runner pain point even when that needs 6-12 words. Do not compress source mechanics into generic labels; stay free of corporate fitness language.
source_policy.rotation_rule: Prefer unused pattern_id first, then unused variation_id, then strongest problem_type match.
